title: Ukraine says rare Russian aerospace sensor hit in Smolensk
big: 19 new stories. The new stories are led by space; the top five are about drones, allies, budget and policy, space, missiles and munitions.

stories.h: Ukraine says rare Russian aerospace sensor hit in Smolensk
stories.what: Ukraine's military intelligence says it destroyed a rare Russian aerospace surveillance complex in Russia's Smolensk region that could spot cruise missiles and hard-to-detect aircraft up to 2,500 km (1,550 miles) away.

stories.h: Space Systems Command to Open $13B PLEO SBS Contract to New Vendors
stories.what: SSC will evaluate proposals in periodic cohorts, with new awards sharing the remaining capacity through the contract's ordering period.

stories.h: U.S. Air Force orders 15 more KC-46A tankers in $2.8 billion deal
stories.what: The U.S. Air Force has ordered 15 more KC-46A Pegasus tankers from Boeing in a $2.82 billion contract modification. By previously reported counts, the order fills the last slots available under the 2011 tanker contract. The U.S.
stories.you: The Air Force has $2.8B on KC-46A. A rival has to unseat that incumbent to win the next lot.

stories.h: First Dark Eagle hypersonic battery ‘fully fielded,’ Lozano says
stories.what: Though the three-star would not share when the first battery was fully fielded, the news comes after the program has faced years of delays.

stories.h: Buried in Italy’s budget, officials see Rome meeting NATO spending target
stories.what: ROME — The numbers cannot be found in this year's Italian defense budget, but the country has achieved a promised spending total on defense and domestic security equal to 2.8% of GDP in 2026, officials have claimed.
